jobs.title: Senior Ethics & Compliance Strategic Program Manager
jobs.description:
Role Summary
We seek a strategic and detail-oriented Senior Ethics & Compliance Programs Manager to lead the design, development, and implementation of innovative compliance processes across our Ethics & Compliance function. This role is pivotal in transforming key compliance controls, with a strong focus on ABAC & Export Compliance, through process optimization, technology enablement, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work with E & C subject matter experts to architect comprehensive compliance solutions that leverage ServiceNow and AI capabilities to build a state-of-the-art compliance controls and processes.
Key Responsibilities
- Design and develop core Ethics & Compliance program processes, translating compliance requirements into scalable, user-friendly workflows that enhance organizational risk management
- Collaborate with E & C SMEs across multiple domains to understand compliance challenges and opportunities, serving as a connector between technical teams and business stakeholders
- Lead the automation and digitalization of compliance processes using ServiceNow tools, AI functionality, and other enterprise platforms to increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve compliance visibility
- Develop and execute multi-year compliance program roadmaps aligned with organizational strategy and regulatory evolution
- Identify and facilitate integration opportunities between compliance processes and business operations, connecting SMEs with relevant teams to drive adoption and sustainable implementation
- Manage end-to-end program initiatives from concept through deployment, ensuring timelines, scope, and quality standards are met
- Support the continuous improvement of compliance processes through monitoring, feedback collection, and iterative enhancements
- Communicate program status, milestones, and recommendations to E & C leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
To be successful in this role you have:
- 7+ years of project management experience, with demonstrated success managing complex, cross-functional initiatives
- Working foundational knowledge of Code of Ethics and Compliance topics such as conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, anti-corruption/FCPA, Trade Compliance, data privacy, and related compliance domains
- Proven ability to partner effectively across organizations, building consensus among diverse stakeholder groups
- Experience with process design, business process optimization, or workflow automation
- Demonstrated capability to translate compliance and business requirements into technical solutions
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to explain complex compliance concepts to technical and non-technical audiences
- Project management proficiency and familiarity with PM tools and methodologies

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with ServiceNow platform configuration and administration, or other enterprise compliance/workflow tools
- Familiarity with AI applications in business process automation or compliance functions
- Background in compliance, ethics, legal operations, or related field
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification
- Experience implementing enterprise-wide compliance programs or initiatives
- Knowledge of compliance frameworks and standards (SOX, ISO, industry-specific requirements)

Core Competencies
- Strategic thinking and long-term planning capability
- Problem-solving and analytical skills
- Change management and stakeholder engagement
- Technical acumen without necessarily being a technologist
- Attention to detail coupled with big-picture perspective
- Leadership and influence without direct authority

jobs.title: Program Manager, Global Partnerships and Channels
jobs.description:
This role sits inside the Office of GPC and is the production engine behind how Global Partnerships & Channels tells its story. The Program Manager, Partner Narrative turns leadership intent into finished executive artifacts: briefing packs, partner narratives, board-ready slides, and governance one-pagers that hold up in front of the most senior audiences at ServiceNow and at our partners. This is a craft role for someone early in their career who writes exceptionally well, builds beautiful decks, and wants to learn the partner ecosystem from the center of it.
The Opportunity
GPC builds ServiceNow's AI-native partner ecosystem across five Routes to Market: Hyperscaler, ISV/Build, Resell, Service Provider, and Consulting & Implementation. Partners deliver approximately 90% of every ServiceNow deployment and source a growing share of the company's new business making the GPC narrative one of the most consequential stories the company tells.
The Office of GPC drives the organization's rhythm of business, shapes how GPC's story lands with our CEO, Board, and partner C-suites, and turns partner strategy into artifacts that ship. This role is the seat where that work gets built. The pace is fast, the audiences are senior, and the standard is high. In exchange, you get a front-row view of how a multi-billion-dollar partner ecosystem is run.
What You Will Do
Executive Materials (~30%)
- Support drafting briefing packs and pre-reads for CEO, SVP, and Board-level partner engagements, Executive Briefings, and C-suite meetings - to standard on templates.
- Build talking points, internal communications, and institutional narrative for GPC leadership
- Turn dense inputs — pipeline data, deal structures, partner scorecards — into short, decision-ready narrative

Presentation & Narrative Craft (~30%)
- Own deck development: structure the argument, build it, apply ServiceNow brand standards, and land the visual
- Help maintain the reusable asset library — partner blueprints, scorecards, org charts, enablement guides, and the GPC operating model walking deck — so nothing is rebuilt from scratch each quarter
- Maintain GPC quality and consistency standards across everything that carries the GPC name.

Rhythm of Business (~25%)
- Help run the operating cadence for the Office of GPC: agendas, prep, follow-ups, and the discipline of closing actions
- Coordinate Tiger Teams and cross-functional workstreams across Sales, Marketing, Partner Operations, Finance, and Legal without formal authority over any of them
- Support GPC Leadership Team forums, QBRs, offsites, and executive engagements under prioritization set by the Executive Office

Reporting & Partner Intelligence (~15%)
- Produce and increasingly automate recurring outputs: the partner lookbook, partner intelligence pulls, and dashboard maintenance against the single GPC scorecard
- Build the support analysis that shows leaders where the ecosystem is working and where it is not
What You Bring
Experience
- 2–3 years; executive communications, business operations, strategy, consulting, corporate communications, or partner/alliance marketing preferred. Or recent MBA graduate.
- Demonstrated experience building executive-grade presentations for senior audiences
- Exposure to a global, matrixed organization

Capabilities
- AI Fluency: AI-led mindset using AI tooling to raise the quality and volume of your own output, not just to summarize
- Concise communication adaptable to complex stakeholders
- Strong presentation building
- Flexible workstyle with strong adaptability for changing priorities and deadlines. Reprioritize without need to be re-briefed.
- Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Teams, and Microsoft 365 Copilot
- Discretion by default: this seat sees confidential partner, commercial, and organizational material

Attributes
- Collaborative by instinct and is able to build relationships at all levels. Ability to read the room, even in senior audiences.
- Ownership mindset: takes accountability for the outcome, not just the task
- Real appetite to learn the partner ecosystem and how ServiceNow grows through it
- Composed under volume — precise and professional regardless of urgency
- Craft pride: cares about how the work looks, reads, and lands

Nice to Have
- Exposure to partner, channel, or alliance environments (GSIs, consultancies, service providers, hyperscalers)
- Comfort reading commercial constructs: pipeline, NNACV, sourced versus sell-through, attribution
- Experience building with AI: agents, prompt workflows, or automating your own deliverables
- Brand and design sensibility beyond template compliance

How You Will Grow
Year one is about mastering the executive materials and rhythm-of-business engine. Year two opens two paths: a defined rotation with one of the global Route-to-Market teams to build partner-facing fluency, or deeper ownership of GPC's narrative architecture. This is a deliberate on-ramp into partner strategy, go-to-market, or executive operations.
Why This Role
You will sit at the center of how ServiceNow's partner ecosystem is explained to the people who fund it, lead it, and partner with it. The work is visible from day one; what you build goes in front of the CEO, the Board, and partner C-suites. For someone early in their career who wants to learn how a global partner business actually operates, there are few better seats in the company.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Launch Program Management
jobs.description:
Role Overview
You love the moment before launch.
The strategy is set. The story is written. The clock is ticking. Hundreds of deliverables are moving across dozens of teams. Senior executives are watching closely. The market is waiting.
And somehow, that's when you're at your best.
The pace of innovation has never been faster. As AI transforms every industry, the ability to bring breakthrough products, solutions, and experiences to market with speed and precision has become a competitive advantage. At ServiceNow, launches are not isolated events.They are coordinated market moments that shape customer perception, drive adoption, and showcase the innovation powering the future of work.
The Senior Manager, Launch Program Management sits at the center of those moments.
As part of the Product & Solutions Marketing (PSM) Launch Office, this role partners closely with Launch Office leadership and fellow launch program managers to orchestrate ServiceNow's most strategic product launches and market activations. Working across Product and Solutions Marketing, Product Management, Brand, Digital, Global Communications, Customer Marketing, Sales Enablement, Field Marketing, Partner Marketing, Strategic Events, and Executive Leadership, you'll help ensure our biggest innovations reach customers with clarity, speed, and impact.
This is not a traditional project management role. Success requires equal parts strategist, operator, problem solver, and conductor. You'll navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, anticipate risks before they materialize, and maintain calm when timelines compress and stakes rise.
The ideal candidate is energized by complexity, obsessed with execution excellence, and motivated by ownership. They thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy solving difficult coordination challenges, and love being on the front line of ServiceNow's most important company moments.
Key Responsibilities
End-to-End Launch Program Leadership (75%)
- Lead planning and execution for Tier 1 and Tier 2 product launches and strategic market activation initiatives
- Partner closely with Launch Office leadership and fellow launch program managers to deliver ServiceNow's most important launch moments
- Build and manage integrated launch plans spanning multiple workstreams, stakeholders, milestones, dependencies, and critical paths
- Translate portfolio priorities into coordinated launch plans that align product readiness, marketing activation, executive communications, and field preparedness
- Drive launch readiness reviews, executive checkpoints, and decision-making forums
- Serve as the central orchestrator across launch workstreams, ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely delivery of commitments
- Coordinate execution across Product and Solutions Marketing, Brand, Digital, Creative, Communications, Customer Marketing, Sales Enablement, Field Marketing, Partner Marketing, Strategic Events, Product Management, and Analytics teams
- Facilitate dependency management, issue resolution, and cross-functional alignment across multiple concurrent initiatives
- Anticipate and proactively mitigate risks, blockers, competing priorities, and execution gaps before they impact launch success
- Lead launch-day command center activities and rapid-response coordination during critical market moments
- Partner with workstream leaders to ensure launch activities ladder to the broader launch strategy and business objectives
- Lead planning, development, and execution of ServiceNow's twice-annual product release customer presentation, orchestrating cross-functional inputs and executive reviews to ensure a cohesive launch narrative aligned to company priorities

Portfolio & Market Activation Management (10%)
- Manage a portfolio of concurrent launch initiatives across products, solutions, and strategic business priorities
- Evaluate launch sequencing, timing, audience impact, resource requirements, and activation dependencies across the broader launch calendar
- Partner with Launch Office leadership to connect product innovation with integrated market activation plans
- Identify opportunities to maximize impact through coordinated launch moments, integrated storytelling, and portfolio-level planning
- Ensure launch activities are aligned across customer, partner, field, analyst, and media audiences
- Monitor portfolio health and proactively surface tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership

Executive Stakeholder Leadership & Continuous Improvement (15%)
- Develop executive-ready launch readiness materials, status reports, scorecards, dashboards, and recommendation packages
- Facilitate alignment across senior stakeholders and drive decisions in complex matrixed environments
- Translate operational complexity into clear, concise business insights for executive audiences
- Anticipate escalation needs and proactively resolve issues before they impact launch outcomes
- Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to improve planning efficiency, execution effectiveness, and decision-making
- Capture lessons learned and continuously improve launch execution practices based on evolving market dynamics and organizational needs
Experience
- 10+ years of experience leading complex marketing, product launch, program management, or business operations initiatives within enterprise technology organizations
- Proven success leading high-visibility product launches involving multiple cross-functional stakeholders and executive leadership teams
- Experience managing large-scale programs with numerous concurrent workstreams, dependencies, and competing priorities
- Demonstrated ability to deliver results in fast-moving environments with compressed timelines and evolving business needs
- Experience developing executive communications, launch readiness reviews, business updates, and leadership presentations
- Experience supporting large-scale customer events, major announcements, product launches, or strategic market moments

Core Competencies
Launch Program Leadership
Successfully leads complex launches from planning through market activation while maintaining alignment, momentum, and accountability across stakeholders.
Program Orchestration
Manages numerous workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders while maintaining focus on business outcomes and launch excellence.
Portfolio Thinking
Understands how individual launches fit within broader company priorities, product roadmaps, customer journeys, and market activation strategies.
Executive Presence
Communicates with confidence and clarity, facilitating decisions and alignment across senior leadership teams.
Strategic Agility
Operates effectively in environments with changing priorities, emerging opportunities, compressed timelines, and incomplete information.
Stakeholder Influence
Builds trust quickly and drives alignment across organizations without direct authority.
Differentiating Attributes
- Thrives in high-pressure, high-visibility environments where launch success has meaningful business impact
- Demonstrates exceptional ownership and accountability, operating with minimal direction while keeping stakeholders informed
- Energized by launch days, company announcements, executive reviews, and fast-moving market moments
- Combines meticulous attention to detail with the ability to see the broader strategic picture
- Maintains composure, sound judgment, and decision-making under pressure
- Passionate about bringing innovation to market and helping customers realize value faster
- AI-native mindset, continuously seeking opportunities to improve execution speed, quality, and scale
- Relentless follow-through and bias for action, driving initiatives to completion despite obstacles and ambiguity
- Enjoys solving complex coordination challenges and bringing order to fast-moving environments

Technical Skills
- Expert in Microsoft Loop, PowerPoint, Excel, and collaborative productivity platforms
- Strong proficiency with project and program management tools such as Workfront, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, Wrike, or similar
- Experience leveraging AI to improve workflow efficiency, planning, content development, or operational execution
- Experience building executive dashboards, launch scorecards, and program reporting
- Strong analytical and organizational skills with the ability to synthesize large amounts of information into actionable insights

Why This Role Matters
The Launch Office is the engine that connects innovation to market impact.
As ServiceNow accelerates its AI innovation agenda, the volume, speed, and importance of launches continues to increase. Bringing the right innovations to the right audiences at the right time requires disciplined orchestration, exceptional collaboration, and flawless execution.
This role helps ensure ServiceNow's most important product innovations become successful market moments, accelerating customer awareness, adoption, and business impact while strengthening ServiceNow's position as the AI platform for business transformation.

About the role:
The Moveworks Professional Services team deploys agentic AI for some of the largest enterprises in the world. As we scale delivery across a fast-growing partner ecosystem, we're hiring a Services Delivery Operations Manager to own the day-to-day operational backbone that keeps our implementation and ongoing services engagements running smoothly.
This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports — a high-ownership, high-autonomy seat for an operator who can run the machine (PSA administration, staffing, capacity, partner subcontracting, and partner program intake) so that Services leadership can stay focused on broader strategy and scale. You will be the connective tissue across Professional Services and our delivery partners, and the person the team trusts to keep delivery operations humming.
What you get to do in this role:
- Administer and optimize Rocketlane PSA: Act as the operational owner for Rocketlane configuration, project setup, user onboarding, workflow hygiene, and closed/won-to-project handoffs; troubleshoot issues quickly and improve system usability, data quality, and adoption across the delivery organization.

- Lead services resource management: Run the operating cadence for staffing, capacity planning, utilization visibility, and backlog alignment across implementation and ongoing services work; connect pipeline, bookings, project demand, skill requirements, and delivery capacity to recommend assignments, identify coverage gaps, and inform subcontractor needs before they impact customer outcomes.

- Coordinate partner and subcontractor delivery operations: Run the operating process for partner-subcontracted delivery, from intake and assignment through onboarding, execution tracking, issue resolution, and process improvement.

- Streamline partner program intake: Manage partner program submissions and operational requests with clear SLAs, clean handoffs, and consistent follow-through so onboarding and engagement readiness move without friction.

- Build operational reporting and delivery insights: Develop recurring dashboards, scorecards, and exception reports that give Services leadership actionable visibility into delivery health, utilization, forecast accuracy, partner performance, and process bottlenecks.

- Improve scalable operating rhythms: Partner with Professional Services, Customer Success, Finance, Sales, and Partner teams to standardize workflows, close operational gaps, and enable a repeatable delivery model as the business grows.
To be successful in this role you have:
- Experience applying AI-enabled tools or automation to improve operating workflows, decision support, reporting, or productivity within a services, operations, or customer-facing function.

- 3–5 years in Professional Services Operations, Revenue Operations, Partner Operations, PMO operations, or a related SaaS delivery operations role.

- Hands-on proficiency with PSA, CRM, or project delivery systems; Rocketlane experience is strongly preferred, with Kantata, Certinia/FinancialForce, Salesforce, or comparable platforms also valuable.

- Working knowledge of SaaS Professional Services metrics such as utilization, capacity, backlog, attach rate, forecast accuracy, delivery health, and services margin.

- Background supporting partner-led or subcontracted delivery models, including intake, onboarding, assignment coordination, operational governance, and process improvement.

- Clear communicator and trusted cross-functional partner who can align Professional Services, Customer Success, Finance, Sales, and Partner stakeholders around priorities, tradeoffs, and execution plans.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to GVP Moveworks Sales (Director, EX Sales Strategy)
jobs.description:
ServiceNow's Employee Experience Business Unit transforms how employees get work done in the agentic era — with a world-class, employee-centric harness that resolves IT and HR requests, enables frontier AI capabilities within enterprise governance guardrails, and is bringing to market the next-generation of AI productivity assistants. The EX BU is the result of ServiceNow’s acquisition of Moveworks in late 2025 and its unification with the HR Service Delivery portfolio. The business is now in hypergrowth and represents one of the most exciting growth environments in enterprise AI.
The GVP of Moveworks Sales owns delivery of the Employee Experience revenue target – and is seeking a Chief of Staff to act as a critical strategy partner, senior operator, and right hand. This role comes with a mandate to define and own the strategic and operating outcomes that directly drive BU performance for one of ServiceNow's most strategic bets.
What you'll own
- Operating metrics, end to end. Specialist ramp-to-productivity, bundle attach rate, pipeline coverage by segment, and specialist productivity. You are accountable for moving these numbers, not just reporting on them.
- Specialist sales as a growth engine. Talent bar, onboarding, ramp math, and territory design as a continuous discipline rather than an annual planning exercise.
- Sales play design and adoption. Work closely with GTM specialists to translate our portfolio strategy into plays that Specialist and Core AEs can land with customers.
- Operating cadence. Design forecast calls, pipeline reviews, QBRs, and leadership staff inside the EX BU, plus the interlocks with core sales and product leadership. Tee up and drive decision making with senior leaders, rather than status updates.
- Cross-functional dependencies that determine the number. Hold the standing relationships with Product, Marketing, Business Value, Enablement, and Customer Success. Represent the Sales point of view with authority to enable cross-functional leaders to act in tight coordination with our revenue priorities.
- Executive narrative. Own the strategic narrative and supporting analysis for executive staff and board forums — with a defensible point of view on what we need to learn from the data.

What success looks like in 12 months
- Core sales leaders and AEs engaged with EX portfolio as a customer priority
- Faster productivity ramp for our Specialist Sales, with a repeatable onboarding motion, playbook, business value case, and assets that clearly reflect our strategic priorities (e.g., key offerings, sales plays)
- Product, marketing, and CS commitments sequenced against the sales plan, with dependencies surfaced early enough to act on
- The GVP spends materially more time with customers and core leaders, with strategic clarity on the 2-3 ‘big rocks’ that need to progress at any given time

What this role is not
- This is not an executive assistant, a program manager, or a deck builder – if you need permission to take action, this role will frustrate you.
- Similarly, this role extends far beyond strategy frameworks and requires a willingness to deeply understand product tradeoffs, competitive dynamics, deal economics, and engage with customers.
What you bring
- 10+ years of relevant experience
- Top-tier management consulting experience at the Principal/AP/Senior Manager; MBA preferred
- Operating experience inside a large technology company, ideally enterprise software/AI
- Go-to-market strategy experience, ideally with expertise representing a specialist sales unit / team
- Startup exposure or comparable muscle — comfort operating quickly with incomplete information
- Strong commercial instincts and fluency with data: you can build the model, find the insight, and defend the conclusion
- Executive presence and ability to build credibility with senior leaders, and the judgment to push back when it matters

Location & travel
- Remote, Major US Metro
- Nice to have: Eastern Time Zone based given the location of GVP
- Approximately monthly travel for customer meetings, leadership offsites, and planning sessions

jobs.description:
The Enterprise & Field Marketing organization in ServiceNow is responsible for driving revenue growth, adoption and customer success across all our direct and indirect sales channels.
As a high performing APAC team, we're looking for a highly organised, goal-oriented, self-directed professional to be a senior player across our APAC marketing insights and operations function. You will interact directly with regional business leaders and marketing teams across multiple APAC markets to play a key role in accelerating pipeline growth and progression, new opportunities, and be jointly accountable for revenue targets. You'll be responsible for driving marketing operations rigor across a defined portfolio of APAC markets or programs, coordinating closely with in-market teams, APAC Marketing Operations leadership, and Global Marketing Operations.
Crucial to your success is having a strong foundation in SaaS and enterprise technology, multi-faceted experience in integrated marketing strategy and program development, relationship management skills, cross-functional coordination, adaptability, and expertise in enterprise technology marketing in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Key Responsibilities
- Own end-to-end marketing operations strategy for an assigned portfolio of APAC markets or programs, continuously unlocking growth, effectiveness and efficiency.
- Act as a trusted advisor to in-market marketing leaders on planning & budgeting, rhythm of business, insights & action planning, and process/automation/AI adoption.
- Develop and transform the performance of marketing activities to build, accelerate and close pipeline, coordinating with in-market teams to apply consistent methodology.
- Partner with the APAC Marketing Business Director and Marketing Operations leadership to implement budget, planning, forecasting and pipeline management tools across the assigned portfolio.
- Run rhythm of business (ROB) cadences — cross-market reviews, measurement, and recovery actions — creating networks and coordination among cross-functional groups.
- Accurately forecast, measure, analyse and report on the impact of marketing programs and campaigns against agreed KPIs/OKRs, aligned to standard sales models (pipeline stages, cycle length, net new revenue growth, buying group engagement, indirect revenue growth, and advocacy).
- Deliver data and actionable insights that inform Quarterly Business Reviews and Pipeline reviews focused on improved performance.
- Liaise regularly with the APAC Field Marketing, Global MOps, Global Programs, Strategy & Ops, and Sales teams to ensure business context, understanding of results, and access to program analysis.
- Build positive working relationships across Major Areas and Global teams, effectively build consensus, and resolve issues within the project team. Work with our internal marketing systems to ensure maximum efficiency, data quality, buying group coverage & accuracy.
- Be a test bed for innovation. Building & testing new processes, automation & AI that can help scale marketing operations and drive systematic growth.
- Mentor and provide informal guidance to junior marketing operations team members across the portfolio, sharing lessons learned from successes and failures. Ensure self and others demonstrate strong ethics and cross-cultural sensitivity when balancing the needs of diverse in-market stakeholders.
- Create templates and playbooks that can scale from a single-market to multi-market context.

jobs.title: Growth Products GTM & Program Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
As Growth Products GTM & Program Manager for APAC, you will be the dedicated go-to-market architect and program execution lead for ServiceNow's highest-priority growth products across the region. Specifically, you will own the GTM strategy and regional program management for Security and Identity solutions (Armis, Veza), AI-powered employee productivity (Moveworks), and the AI control tower (AICT) suite - driving pipeline, sales activation, and customer adoption across India, Asia & Korea, and ANZ.
This is a highly cross-functional role at the intersection of strategy and field execution. You will translate global product GTM strategies into APAC-ready programs that field teams can land and scale. Working alongside regional Business Managers, field sales, marketing, and channel teams, you will design and run the plays, cadences, and programs that move these products from emerging to established motions in the region. A core part of your mandate is driving AI acceleration - ensuring the field is equipped, activated, and executing on AI-native opportunities across all growth products.
This role requires someone who thrives at the pace of a product launch - able to hold multiple GTM programs simultaneously, build trust with both product specialist teams and field sales, and turn strategy into measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes. You will have direct visibility into ServiceNow's most strategically important growth bets and the opportunity to shape how APAC leads the way in making them successful.
Key Responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end GTM program for Armis, Veza, Moveworks, and AICT across APAC. Design and execute regional landing plans for each product, working with global product teams to translate strategy into APAC-contextualized plays, coverage models, and pipeline programs.

- Drive sales activation and field readiness across APAC markets for the growth products. Build and deliver enablement programs, landing kits, and competitive positioning that equip field teams to identify, qualify, and close growth product opportunities.

- Lead AI native sales acceleration across the APAC field. Define the APAC approach to AI-native selling, track adoption across regions, identify blockers, and work with the Head of APAC GTM and regional Business Managers to drive consistent execution against AI-native pipeline targets.

- Build and manage program cadences across all growth products — tracking deal momentum, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution. Maintain a clear view of pipeline health, top opportunities, and program risks across the portfolio.

- Partner with Marketing to co-design and execute demand generation programs, events, and pipeline acceleration campaigns specific to growth products. Ensure marketing investment is aligned to the moments and accounts that matter most for each product.

- Coordinate with partner teams to integrate the channel into growth product GTM motions. Define the partner play for each product, identify top partners by Major Area, and ensure partner-sourced pipeline is tracked and accelerating.

- Represent the growth products portfolio in APAC pipeline reviews, QBRs, and leadership forums. Provide structured updates on program performance, pipeline coverage, and execution gaps — with clear recommendations for intervention.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Digital M&A Strategy
jobs.description:
The Role
ServiceNow's Digital Experience Strategy team operates at the intersection of product strategy and marketing -- where you define what gets built and why. This is pure product strategy: vision, direction, and strategic thinking that shapes digital experiences for a global enterprise AI leader.
ServiceNow launches new products constantly and acquires strategic companies regularly. This role owns two pillars: establishing how product launches reach buyers across our digital ecosystem, and building the playbook for integrating acquired companies' digital presence.
You write the strategy and requirements that guide how Product Marketing, UX, Engineering and M&A teams execute. You sit between product, marketing, and technology—translating strategic decisions into clear direction. You build organizational muscle around launch and integration discipline through frameworks and playbooks.
Key Responsibilities
M&A Digital Integration (80%)
- The role is foundational — the playbooks, governance, and operating rhythms you build become how ServiceNow integrates every company it buys.
- Drive M&A digital integration and marketing technology consolidation, unifying disparate properties into a single ecosystem
- Partner with teams to assess operational readiness and execution risk: systems landscape, team capacity, process maturity, and the cost and timeline to remediate what you find
- Develop the digital strategy for post-acquisition (login/portal integration, rebranding, tech stack decisions, customer community migration, portfolio positioning, site presence)
- Create decision frameworks for integration trade-offs: Which assets stay separate? Which consolidate? How do we migrate customers without friction?
- Establish integration priorities and sequencing with M&A, Product, and Legal teams
- Partner on marketing technology decisions—consolidating lead management, CRM integration, analytics stacks
- Create clarity in terms of sequencing, priorities, trade-offs, and the escalations that keep workstreams unblocked
- Write requirements and direct Product Managers and teams responsible for execution

Launches (20%)
- Define horizontal launch strategy—transform how we showcase launches across our digital ecosystem, establishing what gets featured, how it's presented, and what doesn't make the cut
- Create reusable launch playbooks that enable consistent, high-quality execution without reinventing each cycle
- Define decision criteria for launch prominence and content refresh sequencing
- Guide Product Marketing on what to showcase, how to present it, and where it belongs in the buyer journey
- Use analytics and engagement metrics to validate strategy and refine execution
Required Qualifications
- 7+ years of experience in product management, consulting, product strategy, or digital experience strategy (Consulting backgrounds are welcome with a subsequent operating role)
- Track record of M&A integration experience with ownership of integrations -- you built the plan (for consolidation decisions, product integrations, technical trade-offs), ran the cadence, and held stakeholders accountable
- Strong operational judgment and ability to move between strategy and execution
- Experience with product launches and leading major digital initiatives from strategy through execution
- Strong stakeholder management—ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across product, marketing, and engineering
- Comfortable managing multiple concurrent integrations and launches at different stages
- Data-driven approach to strategy validation using analytics, research, and metrics
- Technical literacy—comfort discussing API architecture, data migration, login/auth consolidation, deprecation trade-offs

Preferred Qualifications
- UX experience or design sensibility
- Experience applying AI tools to work
- Experience leading digital transformation or rebranding initiatives
- Familiarity with marketing technology stacks and lead management systems

jobs.description:
About the team:
The Corporate Strategy team sits in the Office of the Chief Strategy Officer, within ServiceNow's CFO organization. We work on the company's biggest choices: where to compete, how the portfolio should evolve, and how to respond when the market shifts. The team is small, and our work goes directly to the CFO, the executive leadership team, and the Board of Directors.
You will work closely with our Corporate Development and Ventures teams, and business unit leaders.
The role:
You will own workstreams on enterprise-level strategic questions, from framing the problem through to the final recommendation. The role includes building the analysis, writing the story, and presenting it to senior leaders.
What you'll do
- Scope ambiguous strategic questions into clear hypotheses and workplans, then run the analysis to answer them.
- Build the fact base, including market and competitive analysis, customer and financial analysis, and synthesis of internal data and external research.
- Write and present materials for the CFO, the executive leadership team, and the Board.
- Work with business unit and functional leaders to test recommendations and gather input.
- Partner with Corporate Development and Ventures by providing strategic context on markets and inorganic options.
What you'll bring:
- 5+ years of experience, including time at McKinsey, Bain, BCG, or a comparable strategy firm. We welcome candidates coming directly from consulting and candidates who have since moved into industry.
- A record of structuring unclear problems and reaching a recommendation that holds up under scrutiny.
- Strong quantitative skills and financial fluency. You are comfortable with P&Ls, unit economics, and building and reading models.
- Clear writing. You can make an argument in one page.
- Good judgment about what matters, and the ability to work comfortably with senior stakeholders.
- Experience in enterprise software or technology is a plus.

jobs.title: Sr Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Role Overview:
The Senior Customer Success Manager — Banking is the primary orchestration lead for customers using ServiceNow Impact. Managing a portfolio of banking customers, you will serve as a trusted advisor who applies ServiceNow best practices and industry insight to align platform capabilities with each customer’s business, regulatory, and transformation priorities. You will coordinate the resources needed to accelerate adoption, increase effective product use, and deliver measurable business outcomes that maximize the value of the customer’s ServiceNow investment.
The Senior Customer Success Manager owns the Customer Impact Plan, aligning ServiceNow activities, Impact entitlements, adoption milestones, and success measures to customer goals and key performance indicators. They act as an advocate for our customers to drive engagement and accountability, lead periodic business reviews, refine the plan as priorities change, and communicate progress to executive and operational stakeholders. Success is measured by value realization, adoption, platform health, satisfaction, retention, and the strength of the long-term customer relationship.
Job Responsibilities:
- Manage a portfolio of banking customers, building trusted relationships from practitioner to C-level and aligning ServiceNow solutions to multi-year transformation goals and measurable business outcomes.
- Develop and manage Customer Impact Plans that align ServiceNow capabilities, Impact entitlements, adoption priorities, key performance indicators, and transformation roadmaps.
- Apply banking industry knowledge to help customers address operational resilience, regulatory compliance, risk, cybersecurity, customer and employee experience, technology modernization, and responsible AI adoption.
- Drive adoption and self-sufficiency by coaching customers on the ServiceNow Platform, governance, and best practices to strengthen their internal capabilities.
- Lead governance meetings, workshops, executive business reviews, and on-site sessions that advance customer priorities and demonstrate value.
- Monitor customer health, anticipate and mitigate risk before renewal, and mobilize cross-functional teams to resolve critical issues and escalations.
- Orchestrate ServiceNow teams and strategic partners, including Product, and Support, to align commitments, and delivery to influence long-term account strategy.
- Advocate for customers by communicating feedback, patterns, and industry needs while managing competing priorities with clear documentation and consistent follow-through.
Qualifications:
- 5+ years of success in Customer Success or a consultative technology role, driving measurable gains in adoption, value realization, satisfaction, and retention.
- Proven ability to turn ambitious customer goals into actionable success plans, adoption roadmaps, governance, and measurable outcomes.
- SaaS or IT expertise, with the ability to translate ServiceNow or comparable enterprise platform capabilities into clear business value.
- A strong record of guiding large enterprise customers and earning credibility with senior and C-level stakeholders.
- Executive presence and exceptional communication, facilitation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

jobs.description:
As a trusted C-Suite / executive level advisor on ServiceNow offerings, the Principal Customer Success Executive (PCSE) owns the post-sale customer relationship, aiming to increase customer satisfaction and drive retention through Impact delivery. Principal CSEs are experienced individuals who bring a consultative, problem-solving approach to partnering with senior customer stakeholders to derive value from our platforms. They demonstrate a strong understanding of customer’s industry and specific business strategies, driving alignment between these factors and what ServiceNow can offer to enable better business outcomes for their customers. This role drives business transformation by maximizing the long-term strategic value of ServiceNow and ensuring that every aspect of the customer’s platform and capability are ready for expansion.
They provide strategic direction and mentorship to both customers and ServiceNow teams managing complex, multi-workstream programs. They play a pivotal role in resolving escalations and mitigating risks, ensuring adoption and usage is maintained at healthy levels. Principal CSEs focus on ensuring the customer recognizes the value of the ServiceNow Platform at all levels and stages, facilitating a smooth path to both renewal and up- and cross-sell.

jobs.title: Principal Customer Success Executive - Manufacturing Vertical
jobs.description:
The Customer Success Executive—US Manufacturing is a senior individual contributor role within the Customer Excellence Group (CEG), responsible for driving customer outcomes, retention, and expansion across a portfolio of high-value US Manufacturing accounts. This role carries full accountability for the commercial health and strategic growth of assigned accounts—operating with the ownership mentality of a general manager at the account level.
This is not an account-monitoring role. We are looking for a commercially minded operator who has personally driven demonstrable YoY growth within a large portfolio, built trusted executive relationships, and executed cross-functional motions that convert platform adoption into measurable business outcomes. You will serve as the primary post-sales customer executive for your accounts—a strategic advisor to manufacturing CIOs and senior IT leaders—and partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and peer CEG functions to ensure customers realize the full value of their ServiceNow investment and view us as a long-term digital transformation partner.
What you get to do in this role
• Own account-level commercial performance. Drive GRR, NRR, and renewal outcomes for your assigned accounts through proactive risk management, downsell prevention, and expansion motions.
• Engage at the executive level as a strategic advisor. Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite and senior IT stakeholders. Co-develop digital transformation strategies with customer executives, positioning ServiceNow as the strategic platform partner for their modernization and AI agendas. Bring relevant industry thought leadership and a consulting mindset to every engagement. Your executive presence and credibility at this level must be a proven strength, not an aspiration.
• Translate customer strategy into a ServiceNow roadmap. Take each customer’s enterprise priorities—modernization, cost-out mandates, AI ambitions—and map them to a phased ServiceNow roadmap that connects platform capabilities to measurable business outcomes. You bridge the gap between what the C-suite wants to achieve and how the platform gets them there.
• Run complex transformations in our largest accounts. Own governance, delivery excellence, and cross-functional orchestration across multiple business units and concurrent workstreams—defining governance models aligned to business and platform strategy and evolving them as engagements scale.
• Tell the story through data. Deliver compelling executive presentations—both internally and to customers—that articulate the value of ServiceNow through data-driven narratives. You are equally effective presenting a portfolio review to leadership and standing in front of a customer CIO making the case for platform expansion.
• Drive AI consumption and platform adoption. Own AI consumption as a strategic KPI within your accounts. Design and execute adoption journeys that convert license entitlements into measurable business outcomes, with a focus on emerging agentic capabilities.
• Set success metrics and drive value realization. Establish clear, measurable success metrics with each customer. Regularly review progress, proactively identify risks, and refine business transformation plans to
ensure milestones are met and value is realized. Work with internal teams and the customer to develop strategies that overcome barriers on the path to outcomes.
• Champion the voice of the customer. Synthesize industry-specific feedback, feature requests, and adoption blockers into structured input for Product Engineering and roadmap prioritization. Stay current on manufacturing industry trends, regulatory environments, and digital transformation priorities shaping your accounts.
• Operationalize customer health at scale. Define and manage operational KPIs for your portfolio—adoption, technical health, renewals, customer satisfaction, and expansion. Deliver regular reporting on customer health, adoption trends, downsell risk, and advocacy pipeline. Leverage AI-enabled tools and platforms to automate insights and drive proactive outreach.
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience leading large-scale digital business transformations, acting as a trusted advisor to both internal and C-level customer executives. You combine deep post-sales expertise with the executive presence to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with manufacturing CIOs and a bias toward action that turns customer outcomes into revenue outcomes. You will be an expert in governance, strategy, value alignment, and execution across cross-functional teams, with a track record of delivering scalable, repeatable success. Your passion for driving customer success at an enterprise scale and your ability to work in complex, dynamic environments will be key to your success in this role.
To be successful in this role, you will need
• AI driven. Experience leveraging or critically evaluating how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
• Educational background. BA/BS or equivalent required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
• Experience. 10–15 years of experience in management consulting, enterprise SaaS, senior customer success, or technology-enabled business transformation roles.
• Strategic account ownership. Demonstrated experience operating as the primary post-sales customer success executive—owning the commercial outcomes, adoption trajectory, and renewal health. You drive long-term commercial strategy with a deep understanding of how to grow and protect strategic relationships.
• Transformational leadership expertise. Demonstrated success in running large-scale, strategic account transformations and exceeding business objectives. Proven ability to build repeatable processes for scalable execution while maintaining a hands-on approach to ensure critical tasks are completed.
• Business acumen. Exceptional commercial instincts. You think in portfolio economics, understand the interplay between adoption, consumption, and revenue, and can translate customer outcomes into business impact narratives that resonate with Finance, Sales leadership, and executive sponsors.
• Executive presence and C-suite engagement. Proven ability to engage at the C-suite level—both with customers and internally. Direct experience partnering with CIOs and senior IT executives to co-develop digital transformation strategies. You bring gravitas, credibility, and the ability to influence without relying on positional authority.
• Data storytelling. Ability to translate complex adoption metrics, value realization, and portfolio performance into executive-level narratives that drive decisions.
• Cross-functional collaboration. Strong track record building productive relationships across Sales, Presales, Delivery, Product, and Enablement in matrixed, fast-paced environments. You lead through influence, not org-chart authority.
• Customer centricity and industry awareness. Deep understanding of how manufacturing enterprises operate, what drives their priorities, and where friction lives. You instinctively orient around the customer’s outcomes—anticipating concerns, removing barriers to satisfaction, and ensuring every interaction reinforces ServiceNow’s position as a trusted partner. Familiarity with adjacent verticals (Energy, Transportation, Services) is a plus.
• Platform knowledge. Experience overseeing technical account health—adoption telemetry, integration health, platform upgrades, and solution expansion. Background with AI/ML platform products or driving AI adoption programs is a significant differentiator.
• Adaptability and travel. Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, high-accountability environment. Willingness to travel domestically to strategic customer sites as required.

jobs.title: Partner Sales Manager, Indonesia
jobs.description:

Co-develop joint account plans and co-selling motions with selected partners to drive pipeline creation and deal progression.

jobs.title: Sr. Staff Content Governance Lead
jobs.description:
ServiceNow is transforming how enterprise knowledge is created, governed, and delivered at scale. As organizations embrace AI at every layer—from agentic workflows to generative content creation—the ability to govern content systematically becomes a competitive capability. This role is at the center of that transformation.
The Sr. Staff Content Governance Lead owns the governance strategy and execution for the Knowledge Atlas program and serves as the primary governance authority for Product Content across Digital Content and Design (DCD). This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who operates fluently at both the strategic and execution level: defining enterprise-grade governance frameworks, driving cross-functional alignment, and building the operational infrastructure that keeps AI-powered content systems trustworthy, consistent, and scalable.
You will set standards, build playbooks, partner with Engineering on implementation, and ensure governance is embedded into how DCD creates, reviews, and deploys content in an AI-native operating model.
What you get to do in this role:
- Own governance strategy and execution for Knowledge Atlas, including definition of tagging taxonomy, content quality standards, and governance workflows across multiple teams.

- Establish governance authority for Product Content: define what "production-ready" means, create content quality gates, validate agent outputs before deployment, and maintain content consistency standards across DCD.

- Design and maintain governance operating model: playbooks, RACI/RAPID frameworks, escalation pathways, and decision rights for content promotion, agent governance, and skill validation.

- Lead cross-functional governance alignment: partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, and Legal to align on metadata standards, content classification, and compliance requirements.

- Build governance infrastructure: work with Engineering partners to implement governance tooling, validation workflows, and monitoring systems that make governance enforceable at scale.

- Develop training and enablement: create standards documentation, run governance workshops, and coach teams on governance practices as DCD scales its AI-native operations.

- Monitor governance health: track content quality metrics, taxonomy adoption, governance compliance, and escalate risks or structural gaps to leadership.

- Represent DCD in enterprise governance conversations: participate in cross-company conversations around data governance, metadata strategy, and content lifecycle management.
Basic Qualifications:
- 8+ years of experience in content strategy, content operations, information architecture, or enterprise governance.

- Demonstrated ability to define and implement governance frameworks at scale—building playbooks, establishing standards, and driving adoption across multiple teams.

- Deep understanding of content lifecycle, from creation through deployment, including quality assurance and compliance checkpoints.

- Strong partnership and influence skills: ability to operate across functions without positional authority.

- Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to move iteratively on emerging governance models for AI-powered content.

- Excellent written and verbal communication: ability to translate governance concepts for diverse audiences.

- Experience leading or supporting organizational change: deploying new processes, driving adoption, and building buy-in.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Hands-on experience with AI or generative content systems.

- Background in product content, technical documentation, or content operations in software/SaaS.

- Experience with tagging systems, metadata models, or taxonomy design at enterprise scale.

- Familiarity with governance tools (ServiceNow preferred) or content management systems.

- Track record of building governance capabilities in fast-moving organizations.

Core Competencies:
- Strategic thinking: Connect governance design to business outcomes.

- Systems thinking: Understand governance as an interconnected system.

- Influence without authority: Build alignment through clarity and credibility.

- Intellectual rigor: Comfort defining and debating governance principles and tradeoffs.

- Operational excellence: Translate strategy into workable playbooks.

- Coaching and enablement: Build capabilities in others.

jobs.title: Customer Success Executive - German Speaking
jobs.description:
The Customer Success Executive is responsible for providing strategic leadership and driving the execution of post-sales activities across our most valuable accounts within the Enterprise, Industries, and Commercial sectors. This position plays a crucial role in driving ServiceNow’s long-term value by accelerating customers’ journey to success, ensuring predictable renewals, and maximizing the impact of ServiceNow across their business transformation initiatives.
As a trusted advisor, you’ll partner with C-level executives, guide seamless delivery of business transformation, and foster collaboration with ServiceNow’s teams and strategic partners.
What You Get to Do in This Role:
- Drive Post-Sales Success : Own and lead the customer’s post-sales transformation, aligning ServiceNow’s offerings to customer goals, and bringing relevant industry thought-leadership to the table. Foster strong relationships with C-Level executives to deliver on business outcomes.

- Collaborate Strategically : Partner with Account Executives to create and execute integrated pre- and post-sales strategies, delivering long-term value for both the customer and ServiceNow. Leverage the right resources at the right time to ensure success.

- Mitigate Risks and Drive Value : Proactively identify potential risks to success and work with the customer and internal teams to develop strategies to overcome them, ensuring a smooth path toward value realization.

- Focus on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) : Guide and inspire the Customer Success team to meet critical operational KPIs—adoption, technical health, renewals, customer satisfaction, and expansion. Work closely with customers to align their roadmap and drive new revenue opportunities.

- Foster Strategic Alignment : Build relationships with ServiceNow leaders and consistently incorporate customer feedback to drive continuous improvement. Align business transformation insights with organizational goals to ensure long-term success.

- Advocate for Innovation and Continuous Learning : As a strategic thought leader, drive innovative solutions for our customers, always looking for opportunities to help them achieve their long-term goals. Foster a culture of agility and calculated risk-taking within the team.

- Set Success Metrics and Milestones : Establish clear, measurable success metrics with the customer, and regularly review progress. Refine business transformation plans as needed to ensure milestones are met and value is realized
Ideal Candidate:
We are seeking a highly experienced professional with a strong background in enterprise-level SaaS transformation and strategic advisory to guide our customers in their digital transformation journey. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in technology-enabled business transformations, coupled with a proven ability to advise at the executive level.
Key Requirements:
- AI Integration & Thought Leadership: Experience leveraging AI to enhance work processes, decision-making, and problem-solving, including AI-powered automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights

- Business Acumen & Problem-Solving: Ability to identify, analyze, and solve complex business challenges while aligning technology solutions with customer objectives.
- Cross-Functional Leadership: Strong experience working across multiple departments, driving alignment, and managing stakeholders in large, matrixed organizations.
- Adaptability & Change Management: Ability to navigate dynamic environments, adjusting strategies to meet evolving customer and business needs.
- Operational & Execution Excellence: Skilled at designing and implementing scalable, repeatable processes while maintaining a hands-on approach to drive successful execution.

- Customer-Centric Mindset: Deep understanding of customer challenges, needs, and motivations, with a focus on delivering value-driven solutions and ensuring long-term success.

jobs.description:
Role Summary
The Partner Manager owns the health, performance, and strategy of the assigned partners within their territory, with a focus on pipeline development, market expansion, and sales execution. This role translates partner strategy into measurable business outcomes by aligning ServiceNow priorities with field and partner execution.
Working closely with Field Sales, Partners, Marketing, Enablement, Sales Operations, and Technical Partner Advisors (TPAs), the Partner Manager drives co-sell motions, identifies new buying centers, expands into new markets and net new logos, and ensures partners deliver successful customer engagements. This role is not solution- or product-specific and focuses on partner growth, sales effectiveness, and scalable execution across ServiceNow Routes to Market.
What You Get to Do in This Role
- Own end-to-end partner lifecycle management, including strategic partner planning and GTM business plans to drive sales pipeline and growth
- Drive partner pipeline development, inspection, and assist with deal progression in partnership with field sales
- Work with partners to generate new business in existing accounts, new markets, and net new logos while ensuring partners deliver successful projects
- Develop joint GTM plans with Marketing to drive co-sell and demand generation leading to pipeline and revenue
- Advise partners on market, geographic, and route-to-market expansion, including identification of new buying centers and customer sales motions
- Collaborate with Technical Partner Advisors (TPAs) and the to align sales plays to Routes to Market and guide partners on how to sell ServiceNow

- Coach and enable partners both remotely and face-to-face, building senior-level relationships and managing partner risk
- Track performance metrics, readiness indicators, and reduce friction by escalating risks as needed

Success Measures
- Partner pipeline growth, and revenue contribution
- Expansion into new markets, buying centers, and net new logos
- Consistency of partner execution, governance, and project delivery
- Field and stakeholder satisfaction
- Partner maturity, scalability, and enablement effectiveness
To be successful in this role you have:
- 5–10+ years in partner management, alliances, or ecosystem roles
- Strong understanding of partner-led and co-sell sales motions
- Experience developing and executing GTM strategies through partner ecosystems
- Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving, including using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, or analyzing AI-driven insights

- Executive communication and relationship management skills
- Comfort operating in ambiguity with a bias toward action

This role strengthens partner-led growth by ensuring partners are equipped to generate pipeline, expand into new markets, and execute effective sales motions. jobs.title: Senior Technical Customer Success Manager (Veza)
jobs.description:
The  Senior Customer Success Manager is responsible for the end-to-end success of a defined portfolio of enterprise customers. This role carries direct accountability for customer outcomes, including executive alignment, realized business value, platform adoption, renewal readiness, and expansion identification.
Operating with extreme ownership, this role brings structure to complex environments, drives measurable results, and orchestrates internal resources without requiring direction.
We hire builders and owners–not coordinators.
This is a leadership-caliber individual contributor role, deployed against a limited number of accounts to enable deeper executive engagement and measurable customer outcomes.
Role Scope
- Own a mixed portfolio of approximately 10-20 strategic enterprise and mid-market customers
- Operate within a high-touch engagement model where depth of partnership is prioritized over volume
- Engage regularly with CIO, CISO, and senior technology leadership
- Directly influence renewal outcomes, expansion opportunities, and executive satisfaction
- Support customers operating in complex, highly integrated environments
- Identify material risk multiple quarters ahead of renewal cycles and drive coordinated mitigation

Core Responsibilities
Extreme Ownership of Customer Outcomes
- Serve as the accountable leader for the health, trajectory, and commercial posture of each assigned customer.
- Establish clear success criteria and align internal execution accordingly.
- Drive customers from deployment to durable operational reliance.
- Orchestrate the resources required to achieve customer outcomes.
- Treat each customer as a business, balancing advocacy with commercial responsibility.

Executive Engagement
- Build trusted advisor relationships with CIO, CISO, and senior stakeholders.
- Deliver Executive Business Reviews grounded in measurable business outcomes.
- Align platform capabilities to strategic initiatives such as security posture, regulatory readiness, and operational resilience.
- Guide executive decision-making through insight and credible challenge when necessary.

Value Realization
- Build and govern multi-year Success Plans for every strategic account.
- Translate product capabilities into quantified business impact.
- Ensure customers achieve the outcomes that justified their investment.
- Develop referenceable advocates through demonstrated value.

Renewal Predictability
- Own renewal posture across the portfolio with no late-stage surprises.
- Inspect leading indicators including adoption depth, executive engagement, and realized value.
- Communicate risk early with a clear mitigation strategy and path to resolution.

Risk Management & Account Health Leadership
- Bring rigor and objectivity to evaluating account health.
- Proactively identify erosion signals and mobilize cross-functional teams before issues escalate.
- Develop and execute disciplined recovery strategies when required.
- Deliver difficult messages when necessary to protect long-term outcomes.
- Maintain high forecast accuracy for assigned accounts.

Cross-Functional Partnership
- Operate as the accountable leader for customer outcomes while partnering closely with Account Executives and Solution Engineers across the customer lifecycle.
- Align commercial strategy with the Account Executive to support retention and expansion.
- Partner with Solution Engineers on technical strategy, ensuring deployments support defined success criteria.
- Lead integrated account planning across Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success.
- Foster a one-team approach focused on long-term customer value rather than functional handoffs.

While execution is shared, accountability for customer outcomes remains clear.
Internal Execution & Governance
- Coordinate Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product, and partner teams
- Establish governance frameworks that drive accountability and transparency
- Remove obstacles and maintain execution momentum across large programs
- Operate effectively within highly matrixed customer organizations
Required Experience
- 8+ years managing complex enterprise customers within Identity Access Management (IAM)
- Experience within Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) is strongly preferred
- Background in Cybersecurity is a requirement of the role
- Demonstrated ownership of large, multi-threaded accounts with executive visibility
- Proven experience driving renewals, expansion, and long-term customer value
- Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to connect adoption to ROI
- Executive-level communication skills and presence
- Comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-stakes environments
- Track record of proactively identifying risk and driving resolution

Identity/Security Domain
Experience supporting identity, security, governance, or other mission-critical enterprise platforms is required.
Relevant exposure may include:
- Identity Governance & Administration
- Privileged Access Management
- Access certifications / User Access Reviews
- Compliance initiatives (SOX, ISO, NIST, SOC 2)

As Senior   Manager, Customer Success , you will lead a team of Customer Success Managers who partner with customers to help them achieve meaningful business outcomes through the successful adoption and use of the Armis Platform.
You will support your team in building trusted customer relationships, understanding business priorities, identifying opportunities for growth, and proactively managing customer risk. You will also help establish consistent, scalable approaches to customer success that deliver long-term value.
This is a people leadership role that combines strategic thinking, customer advocacy, collaboration, and operational excellence.
What you’ll do
- Lead, support, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers working with strategic and enterprise customers.

- Ensure your team serves as a trusted partner and primary point of contact following implementation.

- Support the team in taking ownership of customer adoption, engagement, and critical issue management.

- Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders and executive sponsors, helping them achieve their business objectives through effective adoption of the Armis Platform.

- Partner with customers to identify relevant use cases, opportunities for value creation, and areas where the platform can address business and security priorities.

- Collaborate with internal Armis teams to align customer activities with their business objectives, strategy, and desired outcomes.

- Help customers understand new features, capabilities, and product releases, ensuring they can make the most of the platform.

- Monitor adoption and utilisation trends and use customer insights, data, and business context to identify opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

- Champion customer needs and feedback, helping ensure they are represented across the organisation.

- Identify potential renewal risks early and work collaboratively with internal teams and customers to develop appropriate plans and solutions.

- Partner with Product, Sales, Support, Professional Services, and other teams to create a consistent and positive customer experience.

- Contribute ideas and improvements that make our customer success practices more effective, scalable, and inclusive.

- Represent the voice of the customer and share insights that contribute to continuous improvement across the business, including product development.

- Work closely with Sales to position and promote Customer Success and Success Services, supporting opportunities for expansion, renewal, and long-term partnership.

- Help develop best practices, processes, and approaches that enable the Customer Success organisation to scale effectively.
What we’re looking for
- 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, SaaS, cybersecurity, or a related technology environment.

- Experience supporting SaaS solutions in a pre-sales, post-sales, or customer success capacity.

- 5+ years of experience leading Customer Success teams supporting enterprise or strategic customers.

- Experience with technical implementations or projects, preferably within IT, cybersecurity, networking, cloud services, endpoint management, or a related field.

- Experience collaborating with or working closely alongside Product Management teams.

- A collaborative leadership style and a willingness to contribute directly when needed.

- Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including experience managing complex issues, prioritising competing needs, and supporting customers through challenging situations.

- Experience with process improvement, planning, decision-making, analysis, service excellence, and developing scalable ways of working.

- Familiarity with SaaS and customer success technologies such as Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar platforms.

- A Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

- Willingness and ability to travel up to 35%.

How you’ll succeed
You’ll succeed in this role by creating an environment where your team can do their best work, are hungry to drive customers forward, and create strong partnerships that lead to measurable business outcomes.

Role Summary
The Partner Manager owns the health, performance, and strategy of the assigned partners within their territory, with a focus on pipeline development, market expansion, and sales execution. This role translates partner strategy into measurable business outcomes by aligning ServiceNow priorities with field and partner execution.
Working closely with Field Sales, Partners, Marketing, Enablement, Sales Operations, and Technical Partner Advisors (TPAs), the Partner Manager drives co-sell motions, identifies new buying centers, expands into new markets and net new logos, and ensures partners deliver successful customer engagements. This role is not solution- or product-specific and focuses on partner growth, sales effectiveness, and scalable execution across ServiceNow Routes to Market.
What You Get to Do in This Role
- Own end-to-end partner lifecycle management, including strategic partner planning and GTM business plans to drive sales pipeline and growth

- Drive partner pipeline development, inspection, and assist with deal progression in partnership with field sales

- Work with partners to generate new business in existing accounts, new markets, and net new logos while ensuring partners deliver successful projects

- Develop joint GTM plans with Marketing to drive co-sell and demand generation leading to pipeline and revenue

- Advise partners on market, geographic, and route-to-market expansion, including identification of new buying centers and customer sales motions

- Collaborate with Technical Partner Advisors (TPAs) and the to align sales plays to Routes to Market and guide partners on how to sell ServiceNow

- Conduct quarterly and bi-annual business reviews, governance forums, and milestone tracking

- Coach and enable partners both remotely and face-to-face, building senior-level relationships and managing partner risk

- Track performance metrics, readiness indicators, and reduce friction by escalating risks as needed

Success Measures
- Partner pipeline growth, and revenue contribution

- Expansion into new markets, buying centers, and net new logos

- Consistency of partner execution, governance, and project delivery

- Field and stakeholder satisfaction

- Partner maturity, scalability, and enablement effectiveness
- 5–10+ years in partner management, alliances, or ecosystem roles

- Strong understanding of partner-led and co-sell sales motions

- Experience developing and executing GTM strategies through partner ecosystems

- Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving, including using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, or analyzing AI-driven insights

- Ability to influence and operate in a matrixed organization

- Executive communication and relationship management skills

This role strengthens partner-led growth by ensuring partners are equipped to generate pipeline, expand into new markets, and execute effective sales motions. Role Summary
Strategic partners win when they are deeply aligned to and rooted in ServiceNow products and technologies. The Global Partner Manager, Autonomous Workforce is a senior role responsible for activating and expanding a Deloitte's defined practice area. Working in close partnership with the Global Partner strategy and team to bring new GTM solutions and services to market. Deeply fluent in ServiceNow technologies, this GPM role translates the practice area partnership vision into customer outcomes, balancing joint global opportunities with the unique market dynamics. As the global owner of the practice area, the GPM is accountable for driving alignment with the partner's practice area counterparts and expanding the partner's capabilities with ServiceNow-aligned products to create pipeline and consistent execution.
The GPM, Autonomous Workforce, partners directly with the partner's practice area leaders to bring the ServiceNow value proposition Autonomous Workforce/GBS: ( AI that works for IT. Self-managing IT operations that predict issues before they happen, automate routine tasks, and let your team focus on strategic initiatives—reducing MTTR, cutting incident volume, and freeing up skilled resources.) into new solutions for the market, engaging Technical Partner Advisors (TPAs) to co-innovate solutions.
Strong understanding of agentic workflows, AI specialists, and orchestration models, including how AI evolves from assistive capabilities to fully autonomous execution. Ability to position AI as delivering end‑to‑end work completion—beyond task automation—combined with a solid grasp of the ServiceNow AI platform and its differentiated Data + AI + Workflow + Security architecture.
Working alongside Geo Partner Managers, the GPM ensures all geo-based teams are aligned and actively driving the joint geo strategy forward.
What you get to do in this role:
Strategy
• Lead the global go-to-market alignment and co-innovation initiatives for a specific Functional Area
• Own and execute the Global Functional Area partner account plan
