jobs.title: Federal Field  Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
What you'll do as a federal field marketing manager
As field marketing manager, federal civilian, you will play a pivotal role in bringing our go-to-market strategy to life across civilian agencies. This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys operating at both a strategic and executional level—shaping account and pursuit priorities while rolling up your sleeves to deliver programs that move federal pipeline.
Working closely with sales, partners, and the broader field marketing organization, you will translate agency-specific buying dynamics and pursuit priorities into account marketing programs that connect with federal buyers and deliver measurable pipeline outcomes.
In this role, you will:
- Partner with sales and marketing leaders to execute integrated account marketing programs aligned to federal civilian pursuit priorities.
- Own the successful delivery of the federal civilian marketing plan, ensuring campaigns and account programs are executed consistently, effectively, and on schedule.
- Develop and activate account-based marketing, partner marketing, event, and executive-engagement programs tailored to named civilian accounts.
- Localize corporate and federal messaging to resonate with civilian agency buyers, procurement dynamics, and mission priorities.
- Collaborate closely with sales teams and GSI/reseller partners to maximize pursuit impact and support pipeline generation.
- Plan and deliver federal-specific events, executive briefings, industry days, and conference presences (AFCEA, ACT-IAC, and similar).
- Use pipeline and engagement analytics to monitor program performance, identify pursuit opportunities, and continuously optimize results.
- Maintain operational excellence across marketing systems and CRM platforms used to track federal pipeline and account engagement.
- Act as a trusted advisor to sales and account teams, helping shape pursuit priorities through data, agency insight, and platform understanding.

What makes you successful
The ideal candidate combines strategic account thinking with a passion for execution in a procurement-driven, relationship-based market. You enjoy building account plans, influencing sales and partner stakeholders, and turning agency insight into pursuit-winning programs. You are equally comfortable discussing GTM strategy with account leadership as you are managing event logistics and campaign delivery.

Key strengths include:
- Strategic mindset: understands federal buying dynamics and translates them into precise, account-prioritized marketing plans.
- Execution excellence: delivers high-quality programs and events across multiple channels with strong attention to detail and deadlines.
- Results orientation: focuses on pipeline outcomes, measures program impact, and continuously seeks opportunities to optimize.
- Collaboration and influence: builds strong relationships with sales, GSI/reseller partners, and cross-functional teams to drive account alignment.
- Problem solving: uses data, agency insight, and creativity to identify pursuit opportunities and navigate procurement complexity.
- Operational discipline: brings structure and consistency to account program execution and pipeline reporting.

- Agility and curiosity: adapts quickly to shifting agency priorities and evolving platform capabilities, including AI and agentic use cases.
- 5–8+ years of experience with direct experience marketing to or selling into U.S. federal civilian agencies.

- Proven experience planning and executing account-based marketing campaigns and events that drive measurable pipeline outcomes.

- Working understanding of federal buying dynamics—budget cycles, procurement vehicles, and the role of systems integrators and resellers.
- Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple account programs simultaneously.
- Sufficient platform understanding to prioritize which capabilities to feature for which agency mission, including familiarity with AI and agentic use cases.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level briefs and talking points.
- Experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms, plus command of Excel and BI tools for pipeline and program reporting.
- Existing relationships or credibility within the federal civilian ecosystem—agency contacts, GSI/partner relationships, or GovCon marketing community experience—are a strong advantage.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment requiring both strategic planning and hands-on execution.
- Open to travel - 35-45%

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - French
jobs.description:
Montreal, Quebec — ServiceNow hub location. Minimum 2 days in-office, with flexibility.
MUST SPEAK FRENCH.

The Experienced Customer Success Manager (CSM) is the senior practitioner level in the CSM job family. You will own consumption and adoption outcomes across a smaller portfolio of higher-ACV, more complex customers, operating with expert autonomy across the competencies and engaging credibly at senior Director and VP level when the situation demands.
You set the play under ambiguity. You recognize when to escalate and when to decide. You utilize the full internal agent stack with expert fluency, lead more tailored Customer Impact Plan engagements with your accounts, and translate commercial context into ServiceNow roadmap recommendations without supervision.
Beyond your portfolio, you shape how the CSM practice runs locally. You contribute to playbook development. You mentor IC1 and IC2 CSMs. You translate patterns from your accounts into actionable feedback that improves the agent stack and the team’s ways of working.
This role is illustratively aligned to a smaller portfolio of higher-complexity customers with larger annual contract value — final portfolio sizing and ACV thresholds are subject to final design.
Key Responsibilities
- Own consumption and adoption outcomes across a smaller portfolio of higher-ACV, more complex customers; deploy expert business acumen and stakeholder presence to drive real, measurable value per account.
- Utilize the internal productivity agent stack with expert fluency — recognize where agents are wrong, override with confidence, and explain agent outputs to senior customer stakeholders.
- Lead Customer Business Reviews at Director and senior Director level; engage VPs on complex strategic issues and reframe problems for senior business stakeholders.
- Set the play under ambiguity — make the right call in complex situations where AI has flagged risk and a human decision is required, without supervision.
- Own a more tailored Customer Impact Plan for your accounts; drive risk mitigation planning and escalation strategy on higher-complexity engagements.
- Diagnose adoption blockers at configuration, workflow, and architecture level; escalate complex technical issues to relevant stakeholders with full context already assembled.
- Lead Impact renewal preparation in collaboration with the AE and Renewal Account Manager; drive strategic renewal conversations aligned to customer objectives.
- Shape the CSM practice locally — contribute to playbooks, enablement content, and peer review mechanisms within the team; mentor IC1 and IC2 CSMs on advisory craft, AI fluency, and value storytelling.
- Translate patterns from customer deployments into structured internal feedback that improves the agent stack and the team’s ways of working.
- Identify and nurture renewal and expansion opportunities across more complex accounts; engage customers to align new solutions with evolving business goals.
To be successful in this role you have:
- 5+ years of related experience in customer success, strategic advisory, consulting, technical account management, or SaaS — with a proven track record of autonomous delivery at scale or in higher-complexity accounts.
- Expert-level capability with AI tools and agents — fluent operation of the full internal agent stack, with the judgment to override agent outputs and the confidence to explain them to senior customer stakeholders.
- Expert business acumen across multiple industries — translates commercial context into a ServiceNow best-practice roadmap without supervision; speaks the language of the customer.
- Presence and credibility at senior Director level routinely, with the ability to engage VPs on complex issues; comfortable leading uncomfortable conversations and reframing problems for senior business stakeholders.
- Command-and-control instincts — leads cross-functional orchestration of ServiceNow and customer stakeholders under pressure; trusted voice inside the customer’s leadership team on AI strategy and platform direction.
- Deep familiarity with ServiceNow platform architecture, AI governance, Control Tower activation, and integration strategy; able to diagnose adoption stalls without escalating routinely.
- Demonstrated mentoring capability — develops IC1 and IC2 CSMs through structured coaching and informal craft transfer.
- Proven track record of shaping practice locally — playbook contribution, enablement content development, or equivalent practice-building work in a customer success or consulting context.
- Outstanding communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead high-stakes customer conversations and represent ServiceNow at senior levels.
- Growth mindset — ready to drive adoption of new agents as they are released, including any future customer-facing agents that may form part of the operating model.
- ServiceNow experience and/or certifications strongly preferred; adjacent platform experience (CRM, ITSM, or major enterprise platforms) considered.

jobs.title: Sr Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Technical Customer Success Manager (T.CSM) to join our growing Customer Success Team, who are a key in helping our valued customers achieve their strategic objectives and obtain maximum value from their investment in their Armis Platform. This will include helping in aligning new use cases to the CISO goals, and identify growth opportunities by informing the customer of our latest innovations, capabilities, and products and match these to the clients’ business goals. In addition, the T.CSM will guide the customer in the successful adoption and operationalization of the Armis platform towards maximum value realization within all levels of the organization so hands-on technical delivery of the platform and configuration is required. The T.CSM serves as the business liaison between the customer and all cross functional teams within Armis, including our Executive team, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Training and Enablement and others.
We are highly collaborative and believe that success in one area can be replicated across many. Our team thrives on going above and beyond to deliver exceptional results, and we’re looking for individuals who are passionate about making customers successful.
Responsibilities:
- Lead adoption and implementation plans for platinum-level customers, ensuring value realization from the Armis platform.

- Understand customer use cases and provide recommendations to improve security posture and platform utilization.

- Build and maintain trusted relationships with technical stakeholders and decision-makers.

- Act as the customer advocate within Armis, coordinating across teams to meet customer objectives.

- Ensure deployment and configuration align with key business use cases and are delivered on schedule.

- Stay current on third-party integrations and how they interact with Armis within customer environments.

- Serve as a subject matter expert in your area of technical proficiency.

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales teams to drive account success.
To be successful in this role you have:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or relevant certifications (CISSP, Security+, CEH).

- 7+ years experience in a Customer Success Manager, Technical Account Manager, or related customer-facing technical role.

- 6+ years experience in network engineering, architecture, support, or design.

- 6+ years experience in service delivery or technical account management in post- and/or pre-sales environments.

- Strong communication and presentation skills across technical and executive audiences.

- 3+ years experience in IT, security, healthcare tech, or similar environments.

- Familiarity with network protocols across OT/ICS, biomedical, or traditional IT infrastructures.

Bonus Points:
Knowledge of healthcare/ICT devices, manufacturers, or applications.
Experience securing IT, IoT, or healthcare systems.
Familiarity with scripting languages (Python preferred).
Ability to travel up to 20–25% per quarter.
For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $87,000 - $152,000, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs.

Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

jobs.title: Customer Success Executive, Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
We’re looking for someone who can walk into a boardroom with a CIO, CFO, or CHRO and be treated as a peer — not a vendor. This person owns post-sales outcomes across the full customer lifecycle — implementation, adoption, and value realization — in ServiceNow’s large enterprise accounts in India, building the trusted relationships and business fluency that connect the customer’s ambition to what ServiceNow can deliver. Success here isn’t measured by activity — it’s whether your accounts renew, expand, and see real value from the platform.
This is a foundational role with real room to grow — you’ll be building the account ownership and executive presence the next level of this career path demands.
What you get to do in this role:
- Develop and nurture executive relationships (CIO, CFO, CHRO, business unit leaders), building the kind of trust senior stakeholders extend over time
- Own the customer’s post-sales journey end to end — implementation, adoption, and value realization — and are accountable for the KPIs that matter: technical health, renewal, satisfaction, and expansion
- Help translate customer goals into a platform roadmap tied to measurable business outcomes
- Set clear, measurable success metrics with the customer, track progress, and refine the plan as milestones shift
- Support and help coordinate co-delivery models across ServiceNow, GSIs, and SI partners so delivery feels seamless to the customer
- Bring a discovery-first mindset — ask the right questions before proposing a fix, and know when to loop in accelerators, advisory sessions, or expert services
- Contribute to implementation and readiness strategies that help shorten time-to-value
- Support delivery governance on multi-track programs, including organizational change efforts
- Help build and communicate the value story for your accounts — able to speak to advisory and platform value, not just professional services ROI
- Champion ServiceNow’s best practices and stay current on how AI and agentic capabilities are changing customer operating models
- Deliver strong, durable customer satisfaction that shows up in renewals and expansion
To be successful in this role you have:
- Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
- 8–12 years in a professional services or consulting environment, ideally with exposure to technology-enabled transformation (Digital/SaaS/Enterprise Software)
- Experience working with or supporting CxO-level stakeholders, with the poise to grow into owning those relationships directly
- Experience at large India enterprise accounts, with solid judgment navigating multiple stakeholders
- Strong command over knowledge of digital transformation — design, implementation, and management
- Emerging expertise in one industry
- IT, HR, or GBS transformation exposure
- Experience partnering with Big 4 or large SI’s in a delivery context
- 2–5 years of experience on large, multi-tracked programs, ideally including organizational change management
- Experience leveraging AI to enhance work processes, decision-making, and problem-solving — including AI-powered automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights
- Prior ServiceNow platform exposure is a strong plus — but we’ll weight fast learning and the ability to translate the platform into business language just as heavily

Why this role is worth being ambitious about
You’ll be backed by proven practices drawn from thousands of engagements, with a clear runway for growth as you build account ownership and executive trust. If you want a role where every year adds visibly more responsibility and access, this is where that starts.

jobs.description:
Global Partner Manager – Autonomous Workforce Practice
Role Summary
Strategic partners win when they are deeply aligned to and rooted in ServiceNow products and technologies. The Global Partner Manager, Autonomous Workforce is a senior role responsible for activating and expanding a Deloitte's defined practice area. Working in close partnership with the Global Partner strategy and team to bring new GTM solutions and services to market. Deeply fluent in ServiceNow technologies, this GPM role translates the practice area partnership vision into customer outcomes, balancing joint global opportunities with the unique market dynamics. As the global owner of the practice area, the GPM is accountable for driving alignment with the partner's practice area counterparts and expanding the partner's capabilities with ServiceNow-aligned products to create pipeline and consistent execution.
The GPM, Autonomous Workforce, partners directly with the partner's practice area leaders to bring the ServiceNow value proposition Autonomous IT: ( AI that works for IT. Self-managing IT operations that predict issues before they happen, automate routine tasks, and let your team focus on strategic initiatives—reducing MTTR, cutting incident volume, and freeing up skilled resources.) into new solutions for the market, engaging Technical Partner Advisors (TPAs) to co-innovate solutions.
Strong understanding of agentic workflows, AI specialists, and orchestration models, including how AI evolves from assistive capabilities to fully autonomous execution. Ability to position AI as delivering end‑to‑end work completion—beyond task automation—combined with a solid grasp of the ServiceNow AI platform and its differentiated Data + AI + Workflow + Security architecture.
Working alongside Geo Partner Managers, the GPM ensures all geo-based teams are aligned and actively driving the joint geo strategy forward.
What you get to do in this role:
Strategy
• Lead the global go-to-market alignment and co-innovation initiatives for a specific Functional Area
• Own and execute the Global Functional Area partner account plan
• Drive cross-geo alignment to ensure a consistent global partner experience across all partner routes to market
• Develop and maintain Partner Executive relationship(s) to align strategies, offerings, priorities, and own peer-to-peer relationships with NOW counterparts
• Advise partners on market, geographic, and route-to-market expansion, BU GTM, Product Roadmap

• Drive in-market execution playbooks with partner & NOW stakeholders to accelerate adoption across all regions & support field sales activation
• Collaborate with Partner Technical Advisors to assess product expansion, route-to-market opportunities, and co-innovation of new technical offerings
Operations (sales & partner)
• Drive operational consistency across Regional Partner Manager teams by developing and maintaining playbooks, templates, toolkits, and repeatable processes
• Support Regional Partner Sales with field sales to support partner-led customer pursuits, pipeline development, and deal progression
• Support regions with domain-specific GTM Assets and thought leadership to accelerate the growth of solutions adoption and sales
• Identify gaps in the GTM process; raise and solve for process improvements that reduce friction across the alliance
Deliverables
• Execution of the Global GTM Plan to expand the joint growth in a specific functional area
• Quarterly & executive governance cadence — strategic reviews, monthly scorecard, pipeline review
• Geo adoption of global strategy
• Partner maturity, scalability, and enablement effectiveness
Success Measures
• Global Partner pipeline growth, and revenue contribution across all routes to market for the Autonomous Workforce area
• Execution of the Global Partner Account Plan and joint GTM strategy to expand the partner’s ServiceNow practice
• Expansion into new markets, buying centers, and net new logos
• Consistency of global partner execution, governance, and operational rigor
• Field and stakeholder satisfaction
• Partner maturity, scalability, and enablement effectiveness
To be successful in this role you will have:
• 12+ years of global alliances and partner sales experience, including business development in Enterprise Software (SaaS, CRM, AI etc…) driving partner revenue and accelerated growth with and through SI partners in collaboration with an enterprise sales force. Proven ability to build go-to-market plans for Channel, SI, and partner organizations
• ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, SAM and SPM product knowledge is a strong plus
• Demonstrable track record of achieving and exceeding targets by managing a small number of large accounts or alliance partners, ideally with a next-generation AI/SaaS company
• Established relationships with major SIs, ISVs, Managed Service Providers, and Value-Added Resellers, with experience in leading software, Cloud, and SaaS organizations
• Strong understanding of partner-led and co-sell sales motions
• Ability to influence and operate in a matrixed organization
• Executive communication and relationship management skills
• Comfort operating in ambiguity with a bias toward action
• Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving, including using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, or analyzing AI-driven insights
Why This Role Matters
This role strengthens global partner-led growth by ensuring alliance operations are governed, measured, and continuously improved. jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Customer Success – Healthcare Cybersecurity ( Armis/ Veza)
jobs.description:
Sr. Manager, Customer Success – Healthcare Cybersecurity
About the Role
The Sr. Manager of Customer Success leads Armis's healthcare customer success portfolio, serving as the strategic bridge between technical teams and healthcare stakeholders (clinical IT, biomedical engineering, compliance, security operations). You'll own portfolio performance across hospital systems and healthcare enterprises, mentor Technical CSMs supporting complex medical device and clinical network environments, and ensure consistent execution of strategies that drive adoption of OT/IT security across hospitals, labs, imaging centers, and clinical workflows. You'll translate healthcare compliance and operational realities into scalable success frameworks.
Key Responsibilities
- Own regional ARR planning and attainment for healthcare accounts. Align resources to customer segmentation maturity levels, clinical network complexity, and regulatory timelines; run cadence reviews and intervene early on retention risks tied to medical device visibility or compliance gaps.
- Standardize healthcare-specific EBR narratives around clinical network security outcomes (segmentation velocity, device inventory completeness, incident response readiness) and risk metrics. Partner with customers on FDA cybersecurity compliance storytelling and HIPAA/HITECH audit readiness.
- Establish and enforce portfolio-level healthcare risk playbooks. Chair recurring risk reviews focused on critical device vulnerabilities, unmanaged endpoint exposure, and segmentation gaps; coordinate cross-functional mitigations with biomedical, IT, and security teams.
- Operationalize healthcare network design reviews and security standards across the portfolio. Define best practices for DICOM/HL7 protocol visibility, clinical VLAN segmentation, NAC enforcement, and medical device inventory governance. Scale reusable patterns that accelerate time-to-value for multi-site hospital systems.
- Run regional Voice of Customer cadences focused on healthcare-specific use cases. Aggregate clinical IT and biomedical requests into prioritized asks (e.g., remote maintenance security, OT/IT convergence visibility, wireless medical device monitoring); coordinate beta engagements and close feedback loops with Product and clinical advisory boards.
- Establish enablement agenda for the healthcare team. Build proficiency baselines on medical device types (imaging, monitoring, therapeutic, lab), clinical communication protocols (HL7, DICOM, IEEE 11073, BACnet, Modbus), healthcare compliance frameworks (IEC 80001, NIST CSF for Healthcare, HIPAA Security Rule), and ensure expert coverage for complex architectures and incident response scenarios.
- Own healthcare onboarding standards and playbooks. Define discovery workflows for multi-facility deployments, clinical network assessments, and medical device inventory projects. Measure adoption of best practices across segmentation, patching, and incident coordination.
- Scale healthcare vertical frameworks. Tailor strategies for different customer profiles (academic medical centers vs. community hospitals vs. integrated delivery networks) and regulatory contexts (FDA premarket requirements, state healthcare data breach laws, CMS security standards).
- Drive customer-to-product feedback loops. Maintain relationships with healthcare advisory boards and clinical IT leaders; advocate for product enhancements around medical device discovery, clinical protocol monitoring, and healthcare-specific compliance reporting.
- Model ethical decision-making on healthcare security trade-offs (balancing security hardening against clinical operational continuity). Hold team accountable to balanced customer outcomes and organizational targets.
- Cultivate a learning culture. Run retros on customer implementations, institutionalize playbooks for common healthcare scenarios (device compromise, network anomalies, remote access hardening), and build skills roadmaps for Technical CSMs working in healthcare environments.
- 10+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Engineering, or Consulting within B2B SaaS or enterprise cybersecurity, with 5+ years focused on healthcare IT, medical device security, or clinical network environments .
- Proven track record managing technical portfolios and leading teams in healthcare cybersecurity, OT/IT convergence, or medical device security.
- Deep understanding of healthcare network infrastructure (clinical VLANs, medical device protocols, segmentation, remote access for biomedical vendors).
- Demonstrated fluency with healthcare communication protocols (DICOM, HL7/FHIR, IEEE 11073, BACnet, Modbus) and ability to translate protocol security implications to clinical stakeholders.
- Strong knowledge of healthcare compliance frameworks (HIPAA, HITECH, FDA cybersecurity premarket/postmarket guidance, IEC 80001, NIST CSF for Healthcare).
- Exceptional ability to manage relationships across technical and clinical stakeholders (biomedical engineers, clinical IT directors, compliance officers, hospital security teams).

- Experience with healthcare-specific cybersecurity or visibility platforms (Claroty, Dragos, Nozomi, or similar OT/medical device security solutions).
- Experience working with biomedical engineering teams or clinical IT leadership on device security and network architecture projects.
- Familiarity with healthcare incident response workflows and coordination across clinical, IT, and security operations teams.
- Knowledge of hospital architecture standards (e.g., AAMI TIR57 guidelines for clinical IT security).
- Strategic systems thinker who excels at translating clinical and compliance complexity into scalable operational frameworks.
- Exceptional communication skills with ability to present security concepts to non-technical clinical leaders and executive stakeholders.
- Data-driven decision-maker with strong portfolio analytics and KPI design experience.
- Empathetic leader committed to developing Technical CSMs and building team capability in healthcare-specific domains.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Moveworks
jobs.description:
As a Senior Customer Success Manager on our EMEA team, you sit at the crossroads of innovation, enterprise scale, and real-world impact. With Moveworks and ServiceNow now operating as one company, you play a pivotal part in a shared vision: bringing the front door of AI to every employee while strengthening enterprise workflows through the Moveworks AI Assistant, powered by the ServiceNow platform.
But this is not a mature, playbook-driven region. EMEA is early-stage and lean. You will be one of a small team covering a large, multi-country, multi-language territory — building the motions, playbooks, and processes that don't yet exist rather than inheriting them. You'll operate with less structure and support than you might expect from a company of this size, and you'll wear several hats at once: strategist and operator, trusted advisor to executives, internal advocate for the customer, and driver of adoption, value, and long-term partnership. If you're energized by ambiguity and by being first-in-region, this is your kind of role. If you want a defined process and a deep bench behind you, it isn't.
Who We Are
Moveworks, now part of ServiceNow, is redefining how work gets done. Together, we combine Moveworks' industry-leading AI Assistant with ServiceNow's world-class workflow platform to deliver instant, intelligent support across IT, HR, Finance, and beyond. Our mission is simple and ambitious: make work better for people — resolving employee needs instantly, automating complex workflows, and enabling enterprises to operate faster, smarter, and at scale.
What You'll Do
- Own and grow a portfolio of strategic customers, guiding them from go-live through long-term value realization
- Serve as a trusted advisor to executive sponsors, aligning AI-driven solutions to strategic business outcomes
- Drive adoption, engagement, and expansion of the Moveworks AI Assistant across ServiceNow workflows
- Build the EMEA success motion as you go — creating playbooks, frameworks, and repeatable processes where none exist today, and sharing them across the team
- Translate customer business needs into actionable solutions, influencing roadmap and product evolution
- Identify, quantify, and track customer success metrics tied to efficiency, cost savings, and employee experience
- Proactively manage risk, expectations, and change across diverse regional and cultural contexts
- Act as the voice of the customer internally, sharing insights, feedback, and success stories
- Support renewal and expansion motions by demonstrating ongoing value and business impact
What You Bring
- 6+ years in Customer Success, post-sales Account Management, Implementation, or Consulting within SaaS
- A builder's track record: you've created customer success motions, playbooks, or processes from scratch — not just executed someone else's. You can point to a time you were first-in-region, first-on-an-account, or operating without an established support structure, and made it work
- Comfort with ambiguity: you make confident decisions with incomplete information and stay effective when priorities shift
- Hands-on fluency with AI in the way you work — using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, or applying AI-driven insights — and a point of view on how AI reshapes the functions and industries you serve
- Experience supporting large enterprise customers and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder environments
- Strong ability to explain technical and AI-driven solutions in clear, business-oriented terms
- Proven ability to build executive relationships and influence outcomes at multiple levels
- Familiarity with workflow platforms, ITSM, HR systems, or enterprise automation (ServiceNow experience a plus)
- Comfort working across multiple countries, cultures, and languages
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
- Willingness to travel across the region as needed (variable, typically 10–25%)
- Fluency in English and German essential

Why This Role Matters
You are helping define how AI shows up in everyday work — and how customer success is built in a region that's still being shaped. Together, Moveworks and ServiceNow are setting the standard for enterprise productivity, and in EMEA you're not just delivering that standard, you're writing it.

jobs.title: Senior Event Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
ServiceNow UK & Ireland Marketing
You will be working in the UK and Ireland marketing team, a team of 9 (soon to be 10!) who are responsible for generating and influencing pipeline for the UK&I business in support of priority industries and solutions. We do this through integrated campaigns that span executive engagement, digital marketing, flagship events, communities and user groups, pursuit-based marketing and thought leadership. The team works together with our go to market organisation and collaborates closely with the EMEA and Global marketing teams.
And to the events specifically covered by this new and exciting role – our Public Services Summit series, SNUGs, our AI Summits and World Forum.  You’ll be amongst some of the biggest and brightest moments ServiceNow creates for and with our customers, prospects and partners.  From industry-specific to flagship moments, pre-sales to cultivating our community, this role will be making a difference across our business. Find out more on these events at links
- ServiceNow Public Services Summits – London example

- ServiceNow User Group Meet-Ups – Edinburgh example

- ServiceNow AI Summits – London example

- ServiceNow World Forum London

What you get to do in this role
- Execute audience acquisition and segmentation for flagship experiences: pull and manage data, build target lists, run and track ticketing against the plan set by the flagship experience lead. Own accuracy on getting the right audience in, on time.

- Create and deploy multi-channel demand generation campaigns (email sequences, organic and paid social, third-party promotion) in partnership with digital teams to drive registration, aligned to GTM schedules.

- Manage all event campaigns end-to-end in marketing systems, keeping assets, audiences and timelines accurate. Act as the operational backbone of event delivery.

- Build, quality control and optimise registration pages for conversion; manage the attendee list from invite through confirmation, maintaining data integrity throughout.

- Run on-site registration and check-in, including briefing and managing desk staff and agency partners for a seamless attendee experience.

- Deploy consistent pre- and post-event surveys and turn results into a clear read for planning and stakeholder reporting.

- Coordinate post-event follow-up with GTM and sales teams for timely outreach to attendees and no-shows, feeding results into pipeline reporting.
To be successful in this role you have:
- Proven experience in event marketing or field marketing within a B2B technology environment, with a demonstrable track record of owning audience acquisition and demand generation for in-person or hybrid events.

- Strong copywriting skills — you can write a compelling invite or nurture sequence that excites and attracts both existing and new contacts.

- Experience working within marketing automation and CRM platforms; familiarity with ServiceNow's marketing tech stack (Adobe Workfront, Swoogo, Marketo, Dynamics) is a plus.

- Comfortable managing data, segmentation logic and campaign operations with a high degree of accuracy.

- Confident managing multiple workstreams simultaneously against fixed event deadlines.

- Experience managing on-site event logistics, including registration desk operations, briefing and managing desk staff and agency partners.

- Strong stakeholder management skills — you know when to flag, when to decide and when to escalate.

- Experience partnering with sales and GTM teams on lead follow-up and pipeline reporting.

- Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making or problem-solving, including AI-powered tools or automating workflows.

- Proficient in Microsoft Office: PowerPoint, Excel, Word and skilled in using generative AI tools such as Claude, MS Co-pilot or ChatGPT.
